intro_v7.template_text: The Oyster Perpetual Yacht-Master II in 18 ct yellow gold with an Oyster bracelet and a bidirectional rotatable bezel with a blue Cerachrom insert.

store.push_text:
Only official Rolex retailers are allowed to sell and maintain a Rolex watch. With the necessary skills, technical know-how and special equipment, they guarantee the authenticity of each and every part of your
Rolex and help you make the choice that will last a lifetime.

features.title:
Cerachrom
bezel insert
features.subtitle: A concentration of high technology
features.text_part_1:
The Yacht-Master II features a bidirectional rotatable bezel fitted with a 60-minute graduated Cerachrom insert in blue ceramic. Extremely hard and virtually scratchproof, the
high-technology ceramic used by Rolex requires special tools for its machining. Its stable colour is unaffected by ultraviolet rays, and thanks to its chemical composition, this ceramic is inert and cannot corrode.
features.text_part_2:
On this blue Cerachrom
insert, the moulded, recessed graduations and numerals are coated with platinum or yellow gold via PVD (Physical Vapour Deposition). The first half hour of the graduation is set out minute by minute. With the bezel in the neutral position, the final 30
seconds of the countdown can be read in more detail via the chronograph centre seconds hand. The graduated bezel, whose knurled edge offers excellent grip, also allows the wearer to easily measure time intervals – for example, the sailing time between
two buoys.

features.title:
White
dial
features.subtitle: Optimal legibility
features.text_part_1:
The display ensures clear readability of the various functions. The dial is coated with a new white lacquer – matt, to reduce reflections – and carries the applique index hour markers emblematic of
Professional category watches.
features.text_part_2:
A flange, dedicated to the countdown function, is positioned extremely precisely on the dial – an attribute for which a patent application was filed. It is graduated from 10 to 0 minutes, with the half minutes
shown as triangles.

features.title:
18
ct yellow gold
features.subtitle: Commitment to excellence
features.text_part_1:
By operating its own exclusive foundry, Rolex has the unrivalled ability to cast the highest quality 18 ct gold alloys. According to the proportion of silver, copper, platinum or palladium
added, different types of 18 ct gold are obtained: yellow, pink or white.
features.text_part_2:
They are made with only the purest metals and meticulously inspected in an in-house laboratory with state-of-the-art equipment, before the gold is formed and shaped
with the same painstaking attention to quality. Rolex's commitment to excellence begins at the source.

features.title:
The
Oyster bracelet
features.subtitle: Alchemy of form and function
features.text_part_1:
The Oyster bracelet is a perfect alchemy of form and function, aesthetics and technology, designed to be both robust and comfortable. It is equipped with an Oysterlock folding clasp,
which prevents accidental opening and the Easylink comfort extension link, also exclusive to Rolex.
features.text_part_2: This ingenious system allows the wearer to increase the bracelet length by approximately 5 mm, providing additional comfort in any circumstance.
